info.title: HBECode API
info.description: Cookie-session API. Unsafe methods require the `x-csrf-token` header (from GET /auth/csrf) and an allowed Origin. Executor endpoints (/internal/executor/*) are bearer-token only and are intentionally not documented here. Realtime pushes: WebSocket at /api/v1/ws (session cookie + allowed Origin); send {"op":"sub","channel":"attempt","attemptId","token"} or {"op":"sub","channel":"monitor","testId"}.
